who.value: buyer searching for a specific item

job.value: find a well-priced listing, using the Good Deals quick filter

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: Query 'iphone', '8 results in Singapore' and the two-column listing grid make it a results page at a glance.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The 'Good Deals' chip sits in the first-fold chip row with a sparkle, and every card carries a green 'Good Deal' tag.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Category' and 'Good Deals' predict what they do, but 'Latest' could be a sort or a filter and the shield chip at the right edge is cut off with no visible label.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Good Deal' tags appear on every card with no hint of what makes a price a good deal (compared with what).

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Only filter and sort choices a searching buyer can make are offered.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Price and Sort sheets are behind chips; cards show only photo, title, price, tag and seller.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything is for a buyer comparing results.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Cards are scannable on photo, price and strikethrough price with no explanatory text.
